content.user_title: Extract Screenshot Features Into Task Lists
content.value_statement: Screenshots often hide product requirements that are hard to convert into tasks. This skill extracts UI, interaction, and business features into organized development checklists.
actual_capabilities: Collects one or more user-provided screenshot paths and related context.
Coordinates separate UI, interaction, and business analysis passes.
Synthesizes analysis results into a unified development task list.
Reviews the task list for completeness and quality issues.
Formats output using the included task checklist reference.
limitations: Requires screenshots or image paths supplied by the user.
Cannot verify features that are hidden outside the provided screens.
Avoids technology stack recommendations by design.
Quality depends on screenshot clarity and available product context.

use_cases.title: Turn mockups into tasks
use_cases.description: Convert a product design screenshot into modules, features, and small checklist items.

use_cases.title: Review competitor screens
use_cases.description: Extract visible feature patterns from competitor screenshots for planning and gap analysis.

use_cases.title: Prepare implementation plans
use_cases.description: Create a structured feature checklist before engineering starts from visual references.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze one screenshot
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner analysis of a single screen
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to analyze this screenshot: [path]. Create a feature checklist for the visible product screen.

prompt_templates.title: Compare several screens
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these screenshots from the same product: [paths]. Deduplicate repeated features and produce one task list.

prompt_templates.title: Extract competitor features
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these competitor screenshots: [paths]. Highlight visible features, unique interactions, and gaps we should consider.

prompt_templates.title: Create a reviewed implementation checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these product screenshots with context: [context]. Produce a reviewed checklist grouped by module and user workflow.

output_examples.input: A dashboard screenshot with navigation, metrics cards, filters, and an export action.
output_examples.output: A grouped checklist covering dashboard navigation, metric summaries, filtering behavior, export flow, empty states, and loading states.

output_examples.input: Three onboarding screenshots showing signup, workspace setup, and invitation screens.
output_examples.output: A deduplicated task plan for account creation, workspace configuration, invite handling, validation states, and progress tracking.

output_examples.input: A competitor billing page screenshot with plans, usage limits, and checkout prompts.
output_examples.output: A feature breakdown for pricing display, plan comparison, usage messaging, payment prompts, and upgrade paths.

best_practices: Provide clear screenshot paths and short product context before starting analysis.
Group related screens from the same product in one request.
Review the generated checklist against real product goals before implementation.
anti_patterns: Do not ask the skill to infer hidden backend behavior from one screen.
Do not use low-quality screenshots for detailed interaction planning.
Do not treat competitor screenshots as permission to copy protected assets.

faq.question: What does this skill produce?
faq.answer: It produces a structured feature and task checklist based on visible screenshot details.

faq.question: Can it analyze multiple screenshots?
faq.answer: Yes. It can compare related screenshots and deduplicate repeated features across screens.

faq.question: Does it choose a technology stack?
faq.answer: No. The skill focuses on what to build, not how to implement it.

faq.question: Does it need image files?
faq.answer: Yes. The user should provide screenshot file paths or accessible image context.

faq.question: Can it support competitive analysis?
faq.answer: Yes. It can identify visible competitor features and product gaps from screenshots.

faq.question: Is the output ready for development?
faq.answer: It is a planning checklist. Teams should validate priorities, edge cases, and legal constraints.
